CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructGet

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Takes the name of a structure as a string, such as "Request.Shop.Cart", and returns that structure. Any part of the path that does not exist yet is created as an empty structure first.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructGet(pathDesired)

Parameters

pathDesired
A dotted variable name, optionally starting with a scope (Variables, Request, Session, Application...).

Returns

The structure at that path. It is the real structure, not a copy, so keys you set on the result appear in the variable.

Usage

StructGet saves a stack of IsDefined checks and StructNew calls when you build nested structures. It is especially handy in custom tags that keep their data in the Request scope.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Neither Request.Shop nor Request.Shop.Cart exists yet --->
<CFSET Cart = StructGet("Request.Shop.Cart")>
<CFSET Cart.Modems = 2>
<CFSET Cart.Cables = 5>

<!--- Asking again returns the same structure --->
<CFSET Again = StructGet("Request.Shop.Cart")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>IsStruct(Request.Shop) = #IsStruct(Request.Shop)#</P>
<P>Request.Shop.Cart.Modems = #Request.Shop.Cart.Modems#</P>
<P>Keys seen through the second call: #StructKeyList(Again)#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructNew, IsStruct, IsDefined, StructInsert
